notes: Background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Looking to power contextual support assistant + on-page summarization + doc search embeddings. Started Redwood hosted trial 2026-02-01.
POC summary (hosted trial): 1.2M tokens consumed over 4 weeks, mix heavily skewed to generation-heavy flows (average prompt tokens 160, avg completion tokens 420).
Observed traffic (hosted): avg QPS 8.5 during business hours, sustained 5 QPS off-hours; peak QPS observed 46 (2026-02-22 11:14 PST).
Concurrency observed: typical concurrency 6-10, peak concurrent requests 28 during product release support window.
Token mix: ~28% prompt tokens, ~72% completion tokens by volume; long-form summarizations (3-5k output tokens) account for ~9% of token volume but drive 30% of compute cost.
Latency: P50 ~110ms end-to-end (hosted), P95 ~360ms; customers want P95 <250ms for conversational flows — currently only achieve this on smaller prompts or with lower concurrency.

Model preference: trial used redwood-curie-1 (quantized variant). Eval team requested comparison to redwood-amber-2 for quality vs cost; SE benchmark shows amber-2 improves summary coherence but increases tokens/sec cost ~1.6x.
Caching: Prefix caching on FAQ queries reduced token usage by ~14% for support flows; opportunity to expand caching to KV-level for session continuity.
Security/compliance: Requires SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 7 years, KMS integration for key separation, data residency requirement: US and EU segments for EU customers.

Dedicated sizing recommendation (prelim): baseline for sustained production = 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (mixed precision, quantized) to meet sustained QPS 30 with target concurrency headroom 40; recommend burst pool (1 extra GPU) for release-day spikes and canary traffic split.

Forecast inputs used: 3-month forecasted growth 2.2x, expected daily active users conversion to LLM calls = 6%, average calls per DAU = 4, median token per call = 340, peak concurrency safety factor = 1.8.

Estimated Dedicated capacity outcome: with reserve (2 GPUs) expect 25-35 QPS sustained for generation-heavy workloads, cost estimate sent to finance on 2026-03-02. With 4 GPUs expected to handle sustained 60 QPS with p95 <250ms for most flows.
Pricing notes: Customer prefers committed monthly billing. Discussed 15-25% commitment discount tiers; procurement asks for line-item showing unit cost per 1M tokens across hosted vs dedicated.

Recent feedback from head of platform: 'need predictable unit economics before committing; if dedicated reduces token cost by >30% it's attractive but must preserve quality — no regressions on summarization.'
Open technical action items: SE to provide detailed GPU sizing workbook by 2026-03-12 (includes latency vs concurrency curves); Infra architect to draft KMS integration pattern for VPC deployment.
Commercial next steps: schedule finance + procurement call (AE + CS + customer finance) week of 2026-03-18; deliver final committed pricing + SOW draft targeting 2026-04 close.
Staged rollout suggestion: start with Dedicated for support/chat and hosted for experimental summarization until dedicated quantization profile validated.
